articles.summary: Inference is where your AI is most valuable and most exposed. Confidential inference runs models inside hardware-isolated TEEs across CPU and GPU, so neoclouds can prove, not assert, that operators and attackers see only ciphertext.
articles.title: Confidential Inference for Neoclouds: Stopping Weight Theft while Protecting Models and Data from Attackers and Insiders

articles.title: AI Agent Security Governance, Control, and Trusted Agents

articles.summary: Zero-days are now found at machine speed, and patching can't keep up. Here's how confidential computing buys back time: hardware-encrypted enclaves and attestation keep a compromised host from ever reaching your data.
articles.title: Time-to-exploit just went negative. Now what?
